discretization.initialization: Taylor start with centered discrete Laplacian; endpoints then use the same boundary update
discretization.final_step: fixed dt, integer step count; never clip the final step
discretization.large_domain_crop: integer global grid indices 0..N; offset 2*N from the large domain

diagnostics.norm: composite trapezoid on nodal values; L2 displacement is not energy
diagnostics.large_domain_diagnostics: full domain; saved snapshots are the exact short-domain crop
diagnostics.boundary_exact: g(x-c*t)+R*g(2-x-c*t), R=-1 for Dirichlet, otherwise (beta-1)/(beta+1); valid for this pulse and time horizon
diagnostics.reflection_projection: final-time signed projection of (short-large) onto g(2-x-c*T)
diagnostics.reflection_fit: L2 residual after fitting the signed reflected displacement amplitude
diagnostics.reporting: retain all results; no prescribed convergence or reflection-success threshold
diagnostics.floating_point: float64; output CSV formatted with 17 significant digits
